sentences.text:
Ratheesh vs State Of Kerala on 17 January, 2024
Crl.MC No.10792/2023 1/1
 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam
 Present
 The Honourable Mrs. Justice Sophy Thomas
 Wednesday, the 17th day of January 2024 / 27th Pousha, 1945

entities.text: High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Crl.M.Appl.No.1/2023 In Crl.Mc No. 10792 Of 2023
Crime No.872/2023 Of Ochira Police Station, Kollam
 Petitioners/Petitioners:
 1. Ratheesh, Aged 34 Years, S/O. Rajendran, Sree Sivam, Vengara,
 Thodiyoor North P.O, Kollam, Pin - 690523.

Respondents/Respondents:
 1. State Of Kerala, Represented By Public Prosecutor, High Court Of
 Kerala, Pin - 682031.

Application praying that in the circumstances stated therewith the  High Court be pleased to stay all further proceedings against the  petitioner in Anx.1 FIR in Crime No. 872/2023 of Ochira Police Station,
 Kollam for offences punishable u/s. 498A of IPC pending before the JFMC  Court, Karunagappally, Kollam District in the interest of justice.

This Application again coming on for orders upon perusing the  application and this court's order dated 13/12/2023 in Crl.M.A.No.1/2023  and upon hearing the arguments of MR. V.S.THOSHIN, Advocate for the  petitioners and the Public Prosecutor for the 1st respondent, the court

passed the following:
 ORDER Interim order is extended till 6/3/2024.
/True Copy/ Assistant Registrar Ratheesh vs State Of Kerala on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/152520794/
